## New API in `layer_manager.rs`

- **`LayerManagerLockHolder`** — a public `pub(crate)` enum identifying the code path acquiring the lock. Includes a `Testing` variant plus descriptive variants for real callers (`GetLayerMapInfo`, `GenerateHeatmap`, `GetPage`, `Init`, `Shutdown`, `Eviction`, `Flush`, `GetLayerForWrite`, `Compaction`, `ImageLayerCreation`, `GarbageCollection`, `DetachAncestor`, `ImportPgData`). It's purely informational and has no effect on lock semantics.

- **`LockedLayerManager`** — a new wrapper struct around `tokio::sync::RwLock<LayerManager>` (replacing the raw `tokio::sync::RwLock<LayerManager>` field on `Timeline.layers`). It exposes:
  - `async fn read(holder: LayerManagerLockHolder) -> LayerManagerReadGuard<'_>`
  - `async fn write(holder: LayerManagerLockHolder) -> LayerManagerWriteGuard<'_>`
  - plus `try_read`/`try_write` (same holder requirement) to support the two non-blocking call sites.

- **`LayerManagerReadGuard` / `LayerManagerWriteGuard`** — type aliases over the tokio guards (so the existing `drop_rlock`/`drop_wlock` helpers keep working).

## Caller updates

- Changed `Timeline.layers` field type and its import in `timeline.rs`.
- Updated all ~81 call sites of `.read()`/`.write()`/`.try_read()`/`.try_write()` across `timeline.rs`, `tenant.rs`, `compaction.rs`, `detach_ancestor.rs`, `analysis.rs`, `eviction_task.rs`, `import_pgdata.rs`, `import_pgdata/flow.rs`, `mgr.rs`, `http/routes.rs`, plus in-`src` test code (`storage_layer/layer/tests.rs`, `delta_layer.rs` test module, and `tenant.rs`/`timeline.rs` test modules use `LayerManagerLockHolder::Testing`).
